Gold-favorable ties: vote@2=0.4839, delta +0.0968, recovered=3, gated-vs-vote CI becomes [0.0,0.1935] — touching zero. Expected-value ties: delta ~+0.113. GATED itself is tie-invariant (0.5806 under all conventions); direction survives every convention, but the tie-robust recovery count is 3, not 4.
(2) STATISTICAL OVERSTATEMENT (reviewer 4, major): exact paired sign test on 4W/0L/27T gives one-sided p=0.0625 (two-sided 0.125); gated-vs-union 3W/0L p=0.125. NOT significant at 0.05 at n=31. The bootstrap CI lower bound >0 is a percentile-discreteness artifact (1.6% resamples <=0 vs exact 6.25% tail), and the entry-level bootstrap wrongly treats f3e62deb's two correlated entries as independent. selection_beats_union is point-estimate-only.
(3) PASS@1 GATE MIS-FIRE (3 reviewers): vote_wins_lost=0 holds ONLY at pass@2. At pass@1 the gate wrongly promoted on 25094a63 (demo-perfect program's wrong output exact-matched a 32-vote non-gold, demoting the 945-vote gold rank 1→2): the docstring's 'expected 0' failure mode occurred in 1/16 fires. Net pass@1 still +4 (5 promotions − 1 loss).
(4) GENERATOR ATTRIBUTION + CONTAMINATION SHAPE (reviewer 5, major; corroborated by 1-3): scored against TRUE Kaggle gold, the induced programs are correct on 26/31 = 0.8387 — ABOVE the pool oracle ceiling 0.6129 — including 11/12 entries where gold is absent from TRM's pool (the gate correctly abstains but discards genuinely-correct answers). Trivial 'codex-first' baseline = 28/31 = 0.903. The lift is generator-attributable; the rerank venue clips it by ~42%; TRM's unique contribution to the hybrid is 2 entries. The artifact's pred_is_gold (gold-AND-in-pool, 15/29) materially understates true program correctness (26/29). Contamination is worse-shaped than disclosed: 30/31 tasks sit verbatim in the public ARC-AGI-2 TRAINING file (the one non-overlap task, 79fb03f4, is among the 3 codex failures), and failures do NOT concentrate on hard tasks — so the 29/31 induction rate has near-zero transfer value. Additionally codex ran with --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox on a host where arc-agi_evaluation_solutions.json is readable and no transcripts were archived: the no-oracle invariant is verified at prompt+code level only (mitigants: 5/31 failures, visible iterative refinement, zero hardcoded grids, no task id in prompt — lookup implausible but unauditable).

WHY POSITIVE_CONFIRMED ANYWAY: every reviewer attacked the headline and every attack failed against the claim AS SCOPED — pool-restricted rerank, disclosed contamination caveat, PRELIMINARY pending the committed 400-task re-confirmation, mechanical-vs-rate split explicit in the artifact. The numbers are real, reproducible to the digit by five independent re-derivations, the gate has zero pass@2 downside on this pool, and the +4/0 recovery direction survives all tie conventions. The 'major' severities are reporting/attribution-level (gates booleans + CI phrasing would propagate a p=0.0625 result as confirmed if aggregated naively), not fabrication or mechanical error. Required fixes below are blocking for any forward-facing aggregation per the fabrication-gate and Paper-v6 narrowing disciplines.
